description: Knobs in AI systems represent configurable parameters that fine-tune data transformations, feature engineering, and model hyperparameters, allowing for systematic experimentation and performance diagnostics. They are essential for controlling model behavior, creativity, and adaptability, particularly in generative AI and agentic systems where output precision and safety are critical. Overall, knobs provide the flexibility to balance performance, interpretability, and user alignment, fostering robust AI model development and refinement.
